sentence: This project builds computer methods that create fast virtual models of patient hearts and cardiovascular medical devices.
This project builds statistical methods for fitting differential equation models to measurements over time and uses them to study human movement.
This project builds nanodiamond quantum sensors and pairs them with light-sheet microscopy to image live cells in three dimensions over time.
This project builds evolutionary models to predict how proteins and RNA interact with one another to form working complexes.
This project builds a neurocomputer from neural cells grown on a 3D scaffold with electronic devices and studies how it processes information.
This project tests a porous material made from wood and agricultural waste that captures carbon dioxide from exhaust gases and the atmosphere.
This project studies atomically thin materials that convert electrical signals into mechanical motion and builds devices from them.
This project builds magnetic soft microrobots that change shape to crawl through porous, tissue-like environments.
This project builds a single well-organized resource that brings together studies of brain electrical signals measured from the scalp.
This project studies how deep learning models rely on shortcuts in data and how to detect and reduce them.
This project brings scientists together to discuss how the solid Earth responds over time to past and present changes in glaciers and ice sheets.
This project makes synthetic dyes that switch on their fluorescence with green light, to track single molecules of proteins in live cells.
This project tests whether flower traits that match different pollinators keep closely related plant species from interbreeding.
This project studies how small molecules that bind valosin-containing protein change cell migration and cell survival.
This project builds tools that automatically design, profile and verify quantum circuits for use on quantum computers.
This project designs materials that combine porous metal-organic framework nanoparticles with hydrogels to release chemical signals that guide immune cells.
